news.headline: Lexeo Therapeutics CFO Louis Tamayo Sells 4,641 Shares
news.summary: CFO Louis Tamayo sold 4,641 shares at a weighted-average price of $4.49 on July 1, 2026, to cover tax withholding on RSUs that vested on June 29, leaving him with 97,024 shares. CEO Nolan Townsend made a similar tax-related sale of 25,947 shares at $4.48 the same day, leaving him with 377,817 shares; both were routine equity-compensation transactions, not open-market conviction sales.

news.headline: Lexeo Therapeutics CEO Logs RSU Grant and Tax-Driven Share Sale
news.summary: CEO Nolan Townsend was granted 67,000 shares of common stock as a compensation award; CFO Louis Tamayo received a smaller 12,000-share award the same day.

news.headline: JPMorgan Lowers Lexeo Therapeutics Price Target to $9 from $12, Keeps Overweight
news.summary: JPMorgan cut its price target on LXEO to $9 from $12 while reiterating an Overweight rating, citing an updated valuation model reflecting the company's latest pipeline developments. The stock nonetheless continued trading well below the reduced target, in the mid-single digits.

news.headline: Lexeo Therapeutics Details 2026 Virtual Annual Meeting, Board Elections and Pay
news.summary: Lexeo held its fully virtual 2026 annual stockholders meeting, where shareholders voted to elect three Class III directors to terms running through 2029 and ratified KPMG LLP as independent auditor.

news.headline: Lexeo Therapeutics Announces Publication in JAMA Cardiology of Phase I/II Data for LX2006 in Friedreich Ataxia
news.summary: Peer-reviewed Phase I/II data on 17 Friedreich ataxia cardiomyopathy patients treated with LX2006 showed sustained cardiac and neurologic improvements, favorable biomarker changes, and a generally well-tolerated safety profile, reinforcing the clinical rationale for the pivotal program.

news.headline: Lexeo Therapeutics Announces Regulatory Update and Registrational Trial Design for LX2006 Gene Therapy in Friedreich Ataxia
news.summary: Lexeo finalized with the FDA the pivotal SUNRISE-FA2 trial protocol and statistical analysis plan for LX2006, confirming no additional nonclinical bridging studies are required and targeting a BLA submission under the accelerated approval pathway in H1 2028; enrollment was set to begin by end of June 2026 and shares jumped nearly 13% on the news.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Lexeo is expected to report second-quarter 2026 financial results and pipeline updates in mid-August 2026 (Q2 2025 results were reported August 11, 2025); an exact 2026 date has not yet been announced.

catalysts.label: LX2020 12-month high-dose data (HEROIC-PKP2)
catalysts.detail: Company guidance calls for a 12-month data update covering all high-dose PKP2-associated arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy participants in the ongoing HEROIC-PKP2 Phase I/II trial.

catalysts.label: SUNRISE-FA2 topline data readout
catalysts.detail: Topline data from the pivotal SUNRISE-FA2 trial of LX2006 in Friedreich ataxia cardiomyopathy is guided for the second half of 2027.

catalysts.label: LX2006 BLA submission
catalysts.detail: Lexeo plans to submit a Biologics License Application to the FDA for LX2006 under the accelerated approval pathway in the first half of 2028.

pulse: Lexeo remains a clinical-stage cardiovascular (and CNS) gene therapy company advancing two lead AAV programs, LX2006 for Friedreich ataxia cardiomyopathy and LX2020 for PKP2-related arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy, alongside earlier-stage LX1001 for APOE4-associated Alzheimer's. The mid-June news flow was the highlight of the period: the FDA-aligned SUNRISE-FA2 pivotal trial design was finalized (sending shares up nearly 13%) and was quickly followed by supportive LX2006 data published in JAMA Cardiology, though JPMorgan trimmed its price target to $9 from $12 on June 25 even while keeping an Overweight rating. Since then the stock has traded quietly in the $4.50-$5.10 range with only routine insider RSU-related transactions reported; investors are now watching for the SUNRISE-FA2 enrollment ramp, Q2 2026 earnings expected around mid-August, 12-month high-dose LX2020 data in Q4 2026, and SUNRISE-FA2 topline data anticipated in the second half of 2027 ahead of a planned 2028 BLA filing.
